column1: # Meaning-critical words: literal signs on high-zoom crops (crops/*.jpg, 4x autocontrast, from the original 2000x2829 ASF images). Sign notation as b35/b43: ' = one dot above, " = two dots, 2. = 2 with dot beside, b = repeat sign, u = che sign. Positions: line, one-based units.

column4: d i s r m a r a
column6: NO sign between 9 (s) and 8' (r): the 'a' of dis-a-rmara is not written. Literal "disrmara"; "disarmara" needs one omitted letter (scribal slip or abbreviation). 6 is bare (m by key). Reading stays, flagged editorial.
Five letter signs l-a-n-s-a, then the che word-sign. No c sign. "Lansac" is editorial: either the writer spelled "Lansa" or the che-sign stands for "c(he)" doing double duty. Keep literal "lansa".

column4: u e n ~ e [f] g/h i e r s [b] / e r a
column6: uenne firm (6' dotted, b repeat). A dot sits between the 4 and the 5: if it belongs to the 4 (4' = h) the key gives "hiers"; if to the 5 (5' = l) "glers". b43 recorded no dot on the 4 (CTX-GH). Dot attribution undecidable at this resolution; "hiersera" stays editorial at 2 units (g/h, i). 3' before it and 1' after it are present (nulls by context).

column6: The 6 in "Lore-6-a" shows no separate dot (8' dot is on the r): by key "Lorema". n is by sense (CTX-MN). "uerra" firm (8' + repeat sign).

column6: Firm. Dotted 4 before it is present (null by context).

column6: Firm; dot above-left of the 6 seen (n).

column6: No dot seen over the 5 at unit 12 (b43 token 5', class CTX-UNC). Literal by what is visible: "mirandoia"; l by sense. The dot nearby belongs to the following 2' (null).

The P-sign is a 7 with TWO dots (key: null). The p of "parimente" (V06:38) also looks two-dotted at this zoom (b43 read it 7' = p on image). So either 7" is a p-variant here or both are misread dots. "Parma" stays editorial at its first letter.

column3: S (isolated capital, space each side; R23 followed by a point "S.")
column6: Code sign confirmed as a large plain capital S in both places. Value "Siena" is context only (not fixed by any duplicate).

column6: Reads "el dj xx. m" with a bar: the reviewer's "el dj xx. m̄" is supported. The first word is "el", not "al". No "arzo" in writing ink; b43's "r-like stroke" is in bleed-through tone. The bar may be an abbreviation mark on m, or a numeral overline over xx extended across m: not decided. Month NOT established.
